limitations: Function inclusive times overlap; do not sum DB/driver/probe/control layers
Connect counts include denied attempts; role-specific authorization/TLS tests still use fresh connections
cProfile adds unremoved overhead; no statistical improvement or causal overhead estimate from before/profile/after
Current worker thread only; excludes API and lease keeper threads and work outside _step
Local native process and real TLS PostgreSQL with separate databases, not the fixed product image or the earlier actual Pod/HTTPS load run
No client load; existing native fixture budgets are 60/120 seconds, not evidence of 5-second completion qualification
Synthetic IdP/plan/trust bootstrap and local file witness remain; not real cloud/onprem operational acceptance
No raw pstats, SQL, DSNs, arguments, return bodies or exception messages exported by profiler
Timing metadata does not authenticate evidence or grant execution authority
